title: security-review scope manifest
description: Explicit, signed authorization to test a fixed set of endpoints. No wildcards, no open lists, no redirect allow-list: every target is one exact scheme://host:port.

targets.description: Exactly the endpoints that may be touched. Each entry is scheme://host:port.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 instant with timezone offset, e.g. 2026-12-31T23:59:59Z.

maxSeconds.description: Wall-clock budget for the whole run.

maxDiskMB.description: Disk budget for the run's working directory.

createdBy.description: Free text identifying who authorized the test, e.g. an email address.
